📺 The Guest Book (2017–2018)

The Guest Book follows the hilarious and unpredictable experiences of visitors staying at a small vacation rental property, where every guest arrives with their own secrets, personal problems, and unusual adventures. Set in the fictional mountain town of Mount Trace during its first season and a beachside community during its second, the series explores the lives of strangers whose seemingly ordinary vacations turn into chaotic situations filled with misunderstandings, unexpected romances, family conflicts, and outrageous decisions. Each episode introduces new guests while familiar local characters connect their stories, creating an entertaining mix of comedy and heartfelt moments. Featuring an ensemble cast including Carly Jibson, Eddie Steeples, and Charlie Robinson, the series delivers quirky humor, surprising twists, and unforgettable characters while exploring relationships, friendship, love, and the unpredictable ways people’s lives can intersect.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Anthology • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Greg Garcia

📺 Seasons: 2 • 20 Episodes

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Guest Book is an American anthology comedy television series created by Greg Garcia. Season 1 stars Charlie Robinson, Carly Jibson, Lou Wilson, and Kellie Martin, while season 2 stars Jibson, Eddie Steeples, Kimiko Glenn, Jimmy Tatro, and Dan Beirne. The series centers on the lives of the employees of, and visitors to, vacation rental properties: season 1 focuses on the renters of Froggy Cottage in the small mountain town of Mount Trace, while season 2 follows the renters of Barefeet Retreat in the oceanside town of Mabel Beach.
